paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jerusalem kumpipa Adoni-zedek in Joshua in Ai khua ala a, ahihsegawp dimdem a, Jeriko khua leh akumpipa ahihsiat bang in Ai khua leh akumpipa leng ahihsegawp a, Gibeon a mite'n Israelte toh lemna bawl in, alak uah ateng sam uh, chih azak in, alauta mahmah hi.
heading: Amorte Zoh Ahi Uh
english: Now when Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them,

paite: Gibeon khua bel lianpi, kumpipa khopite lak a khat bang a lian ahi. Ai khua sang a lianzaw leh amite leng hattak ahih ziak un alau mahmah uhi.
english: they were very afraid, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all its men were mighty.

paite: Huaiziak in Jerusalem kumpipa Adoni-zedek in Hebron kumpipa Hoham, Jermuth kumpina Piram. Lakish kumpipa Japhia leh Eglon kumpipa Debir kiang ah,
english: Therefore Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish, and Debir king of Eglon, saying,

paite: "Hong pai unla, hong panpih un, Gibeon i va dou ding uh. Joshua leh Israel suante toh lemna abawl ngal ua," chi in athukhak hi.
english: “Come up to me and help me. Let’s strike Gibeon; for they have made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.”

paite: Amorte kumpipa ngate: Jerusalem kumpipa, Hebron kumpipa, Jermuth kumpipa, Lakish kumpipa leh Eglon kumpipa akikhawm ua, asepaih tengteng uh toh ahohtou ua, Gibeon kho zawn ah giahphual sat in adouta uhi.
english: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together and went up, they and all their armies, and encamped against Gibeon, and made war against it.

paite: Gibeonte'n Gilgal giahphual a om Joshua kiang ah mi asawl ua, "Na sikhate hon nuse ke'n. Kintak in ka kiang uah hong tou in, hong panpih inla, hong hondam in. Singtang gam a teng Amor kumpipate kou hong dou ding in akikhawm uh," chi in ava hilh uhi.
heading: Gibeonte'n Joshua Ngetna
english: The men of Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, saying, “Don’t abandon your servants! Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us; for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the hill country have gathered together against us.”

paite: Joshua leh akiang a gal dou thei mi tengteng leh mihat hangsan tengteng Gilgal a pan ahohtou uhi.
english: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and the whole army with him, including all the mighty men of valor.

paite: TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Amaute lau het ke'n. Na khut ah ka hon pe khinta hi. Alak ua mi kuamah na ma ah adingh zou kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t fear them, for I have delivered them into your hands. Not a man of them will stand before you.”

paite: Huaiziak in Joshua in amaute adou guih a; zankhua a Gilgal a pan ana hohtousa ahi.
english: Joshua therefore came to them suddenly. He marched from Gilgal all night.

paite: TOUPA'N Israelte ma ah amaute ahihbuai gawpta a, Gibeon ah tampi athat a, Beth-horon zottouhna lampi ah adelh a, Azekah leh Makkedah kho pha in athat hi.
english: Yahweh confused them before Israel. He killed them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them by the way of the ascent of Beth Horon, and struck them to Azekah and to Makkedah.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israelte ma ah ataikek ua, Beth-horon a pan apaisukna mun a a-om lai un, TOUPA'N van a pan gial lian pipi atung uah Azekah kho pha in akesak a, asi uhi. Israel suante'n namsau a asatlup sang un gial denlup atamzaw hi.
english: As they fled from before Israel, while they were at the descent of Beth Horon, Yahweh hurled down great stones from the sky on them to Azekah, and they died. There were more who died from the hailstones than those whom the children of Israel killed with the sword.

paite: TOUPA'N Amorte Israel suante apiak ni in Joshua in TOUPA kiang h thu agen a; Israelte mitmuh in, "Ni, Gibeon kho tung ah dingh nilouh in; kha, nang leng, Aijalon Phaizang ah om nilouh in," achi hi.
english: Then Joshua spoke to Yahweh in the day when Yahweh delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel. He said in the sight of Israel, “Sun, stand still on Gibeon! You, moon, stop in the valley of Aijalon!”

paite: Mite'n amelmate uh tung a phu alak masiah uh ni adingh daikinken a, kha leng a-om nilouh hi. Hiai thu Jasar laibu a gelh hilou hia? Huchi in van lai ah ni a-om nilouh a, ni khat sung vengveng tum thu angaihtuah kei hi.
english: The sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the nation had avenged themselves of their enemies. Isn’t this written in the book of Jashar? The sun stayed in the middle of the sky, and didn’t hurry to go down about a whole day.

paite: TOUPA'N huchibang a mihing aw angaihkhiak ni, ama in a-om ngei kei a anung in leng a-om ngei kei; TOUPA'N lah Israelte adoupih ngal a.
english: There was no day like that before it or after it, that Yahweh listened to the voice of a man; for Yahweh fought for Israel.

paite: Joshua leh Israelte agiahphual uh Gilgal ah akik nawn vek uhi.
english: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.

paite: Huai kumpipa ngate ataimang ua, Makkedah kokhuk ah akibu uhi.
heading: Joshua In Amor Kumpipate Nga Aman
english: These five kings fled, and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah.

paite: "Makkedah kokhuk a kibu, kumpipa ngate muh ahi uh," chi in Joshua hilh in a-om hi.
english: Joshua was told, saying, “The five kings have been found, hidden in the cave at Makkedah.”

paite: Joshua in, "Kokhuk kam suang lianpi khuk in sin unla, veng mite leng omsak un.
english: Joshua said, “Roll large stones to cover the cave’s entrance, and set men by it to guard them;

paite: Noute bel om kei unla; na melmate uh delh unla, anungdalte that unla; akhua himhim uah lutsak kei un. TOUPA na Pathian un na khut uah amau ahon peta ngal a," achi hi.
english: but don’t stay there. Pursue your enemies, and attack them from the rear. Don’t allow them to enter into their cities; for Yahweh your God has delivered them into your hand.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Joshua leh Israel suante'n athah bei khit ua, kulhbaangpi nei khuate a, a-omlaite atailut khit un,
english: When Joshua and the children of Israel had finished killing them with a very great slaughter until they were consumed, and the remnant which remained of them had entered into the fortified cities,

paite: mi tengteng Joshua kiang Makkedah ah galmuangtak in ahong kik nawn ua. Israel suante dem in kuamah in lei alok ngam kei uh.
english: all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace. None moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.

paite: Joshua in, "Kokhuk kam hong unla, kokhuk a pan ka kiang ah kumpipa ngate hon kaikhia un," achi hi.
english: Then Joshua said, “Open the cave entrance, and bring those five kings out of the cave to me.”

paite: Hichibang in ahih ua, kumpipa ngate: Jerusalem kumpipa, Hebron kumpipa, Jermuth kumpipa, Lakish kumpipa leh Eglon kumpipa kokhuk a pan akiang ah ahon pikhia uhi.
english: They did so, and brought those five kings out of the cave to him: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipate Joshua kiang a ahon pitak un, Joshua in Israel tengteng asamkhawm a, amah toh kuan galdou thei mite lak a heutute kiang ah, "Hong pai nai unla, hiai kumpipate ngawng sik un," achi hi. Huchi in ahong pai nai ua, angawng uh ahong siksak uhi.
english: When they brought those kings out to Joshua, Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said to the chiefs of the men of war who went with him, “Come near. Put your feet on the necks of these kings.” They came near, and put their feet on their necks.

paite: Joshua in akiang uah, "Lau kei unla, lunglel sam kei un. Hattak leh hangsantak in om un. Na dou uh na melma tengteng tung ah TOUPA'N hichibang in ahih ding," achi hi.
english: Joshua said to them, “Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed. Be strong and courageous, for Yahweh will do this to all your enemies against whom you fight.”

paite: Huai khit in Joshua in amau asatzan a, athat a, sing dawn ah akhai a; nitaklam tan in sing dawn ah akikhai lai uhi.
english: Afterward Joshua struck them, put them to death, and hanged them on five trees. They were hanging on the trees until the evening.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, nitum kuan in Joshua in thu apia a, sing dawn a pan alakhia ua, akibukna kokhuk uah apailut ua, akokhuk kam suang lianpi in asin ua, tuni tan in leng a-om lai hi.
english: At the time of the going down of the sun, Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and threw them into the cave in which they had hidden themselves, and laid great stones on the mouth of the cave, which remain to this very day.

paite: Joshua in huai ni in Makkedah khua ala a, akumpipa uh tan in namsau in alok a; huai khua a om tengteng asatlum vek a, khat lel leng hawi anei kei. Jeriko kumpipa tung a ahih mah bang in, Makkedah kumpipa tung ah leng ahihta hi.
heading: Joshua In Amorte Gam Alakbeh Lai
english: Joshua took Makkedah on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king. He utterly destroyed it and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining. He did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.

paite: Joshua Israel tengteng toh Makkedah a pan Libnah ah apai ua, Libnah khua adou uhi.
english: Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah, and fought against Libnah.

paite: TOUPA'N huai khua kumpipa tan in Israelte khut ah apia hi. Huai khua dou in asung a om tengteng athat vek hi. Asung a om mi khat mah leng hinghawi anei kei hi. Jeriko kumpipa tung a ahih mah bang in akumpipa tung ah ahih hi.
english: Yahweh delivered it also, with its king, into the hand of Israel. He struck it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining in it. He did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.

paite: Joshua Israel tengteng toh Libnah a pan Lakish ah apai ua, panmun khoh in asual uhi.
english: Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, to Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it.

paite: TOUPA'N Lakish khua Israelte khut ah apia a, ani nih ni in ala ua huai khua dou in asung a om tengteng namsau in athat vek ua, Libnah khote tung a ahih bang in ahihta uhi.
english: Yahweh delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel. He took it on the second day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with all the souls who were in it, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

paite: Bezer kumpipa Horam, Lakish khua panpih ding in akuantou a; Joshua in amah leh aheute nangawn khat mah leng hawi lou in athatgam vek hi.
english: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua struck him and his people, until he had left him no one remaining.

paite: Joshua Israel tengteng toh Lakish a pan Eglon ah apai ua, panmun akhoh ua; adou uhi.
english: Joshua passed from Lachish, and all Israel with him, to Eglon; and they encamped against it and fought against it.

paite: Huai ni in ala ua, huai ni mah in huai khua dou in asung a om tengteng namsau in athat bei sipsip hi. Lakish kho tung a ahih bang in ahihta hi.
english: They took it on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword. He utterly destroyed all the souls who were in it that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.

paite: Joshua, Israelte tengteng toh Eglon a pan Hebron ah apai ua adou uhi.
english: Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, to Hebron; and they fought against it.

paite: Ala ua, huai khua, akumpipa, akhopel tengteng leh asung a om tengteng namsau a dou in athat vek ua, Eglon kho tung a hih bang in khat mah leng hinghawi anei kei hi. Akhua nangawn hihse vek in asung a om tengteng athat bei sipsip hi.
english: They took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king and all its cities, and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but he utterly destroyed it, and all the souls who were in it.

paite: Joshua leh Israel tengteng Debir ah akihei nawn ua adou ua;
english: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir, and fought against it.

paite: huai khua, akumpipa leh akhopel tengteng ala ua; namsau in adou ua, asung a om tengteng athat bei sipsip ua; khat mah leng hawi anei kei uh. Hebron kho tung leh Debir khua leh akumpipa uh tung a ahih bang in ahihta hi.
english: He took it, with its king and all its cities. They struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining. As he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to its king; as he had done also to Libnah, and to its king.

paite: Huchi in Joshua in agam pumpi, tanggamte, simlam a phaizang leh mual gamte hihse vek in akumpipa tengteng uh athat vek a; khat mah hinghawi anei kei hi. TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian thupiak bang in anak thei peuhmah ahihchimit vek hi.
english: So Joshua struck all the land, the hill country, the South, the lowland, the slopes, and all their kings. He left no one remaining, but he utterly destroyed all that breathed, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, commanded.

paite: Joshua in Kadesh-barnea a pan Gaza pha in, Goshen gam tengteng toh Gibeon pha in ahihse vek hi.
english: Joshua struck them from Kadesh Barnea even to Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even to Gibeon.

paite: Huai kumpipate tengteng leh agam uh TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in Israelte adoupih ziak in, Joshua in hun khat a alak vek ahi uhi.
english: Joshua took all these kings and their land at one time because Yahweh, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.

paite: Joshua leh Israel tengteng a giahphual Gilgal ah akik nawn vek uhi.
english: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.
